patches.rationale: Align the model spec with the required phase-1 callable path, fixture evidence, and contract fields.
Expose a unified JSON schema and lazy CPU-only model wrapper after repo-native contract validation.
Route MCP calls through the updated minimal wrapper.
Re-export the updated wrapper and result types without heavy side effects.
Describe the CPU-only minimal wrapper and schema-facing tool behavior.
Create a reproducible uv-based model-local environment with local cache and temp paths.
Provide an explicit contract validator that can be reused during repro replay.
Freeze the minimal callable path into a direct replay script for fresh-directory validation.
